title: fix(lint): a validation rule's expression finding carries the slot's key path
body:
domain:spec#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzj2PNcHjESYvrviQf7

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBSqjVuhLMsVzHs6jpRpHNTh)_

Fixes #27643

Part of #27482 (layer 1 of 2, the producer; the Studio reader, layer 2, stays on #27482).

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Both declarations are the claim's, measured and kept: no accept set moves (every body that saved or published before does so now, every refusal still refuses with the same rule, `where` and message); only the locator of an existing refusal changes, and no metadata key or value is touched. They match what PR #26999 (#26858, the flow-edge precedent) declared for the same kind of change: `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, one `@objectstack/lint` patch changeset. `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` publishes nothing new here (its diff is one test file), so it has no changeset line.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：对象校验规则（`validations[]`）表达式被拒时，发现项的 `path` 从描述文字（`object 'X' · validation rule 'R'`）改为键路径（`objects[0].validations[1].condition`）；草稿读取的 `_diagnostics[].path` 因此变成 `validations.1.condition`，发布 422 的 `issues[].path` 变成 `objects.X.validations[1].condition`。`where` 文字不变。
- 为什么改：Studio 按字段路径对号显示服务端结论；流程连线条件已经这样做（#26858），校验规则此前只有描述文字，界面对不上号，无法据此暂停自动保存（#27482 第 2 层要用）。
- 风险与回滚：拒绝与放行完全不变，只换定位字段；直接读 `path` 文字的调用方会看到新拼写（仓内已查遍，见 Acceptance notes）。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts`（对象校验规则循环里的 `atSlot`），`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.runtime-authoring-gate.test.ts`（#22032 块新增的草稿读取断言），`packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.validation-rule-path.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/validate-expressions.validation-rule-path.test.ts`，应 9/9 全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（契约复核后）。

## What changes

### Measured first, on `origin/main` `b761968d`

A draft of an object whose `amount` field is nullable, with three rules (`ok_rule` clean; `amount_rule` `record.amount > 100`; a `conditional` `cond_rule` with `when: record.amount > 5` and `then` → `inner` `record.amount < 1000`), saved through the real `saveMetaItem` (draft), read with `getMetaItem({ state: 'draft' })`, then published:

Before (`_diagnostics.errors[]`, then the publish 422 `issues[]` path / where):

```text
{ path: "object 'rule_probe' · validation rule 'amount_rule'",                 code: "expression-invalid" }
{ path: "object 'rule_probe' · validation rule 'cond_rule' when-predicate",    code: "expression-invalid" }
{ path: "object 'rule_probe' · validation rule 'cond_rule' then → 'inner'",    code: "expression-invalid" }
422 path = where = "object 'rule_probe' · validation rule 'amount_rule'"   (and likewise for the other two)
```

The flow-edge precedent on the same harness (the #26707 `edge_cel` flow, edge `e2` condition `record.name ==`):

```text
{ path: "edges.1.condition", code: "expression-invalid" }
422 path = "flows[0].edges[1].condition", where = "flow 'edge_cel' · edge 'e2' (decide→end) condition"
```

After, at this PR's head (same probe):

```text
{ path: "validations.1.condition",      code: "expression-invalid" }
{ path: "validations.2.when",           code: "expression-invalid" }
{ path: "validations.2.then.condition", code: "expression-invalid" }
422 path = "objects.rule_probe.validations[1].condition",      where = "object 'rule_probe' · validation rule 'amount_rule'"
422 path = "objects.rule_probe.validations[2].when",           where = "object 'rule_probe' · validation rule 'cond_rule' when-predicate"
422 path = "objects.rule_probe.validations[2].then.condition", where = "object 'rule_probe' · validation rule 'cond_rule' then → 'inner'"
```

Messages are byte-identical before and after.

### The producer (`packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts`)

- The object validation-rule loop computes the rule's key path over the lists as authored (`objects[I].validations[N]`, `indexOf` on the raw arrays, the #26858 spelling), and stamps `${rulePath}.${slot}` onto every issue each slot's call pushes. That covers all three verdicts the pass gives: `check()` (syntax, bare refs, unknown fields, hop checks), the `parent` root verdict (#24720) and `checkNullGuards` (#4763).
- The expression slots a rule has, measured from `rulePredicates` and the loop: `condition` and `when` on the rule itself, and the same two on every `conditional` rule nested under `then` / `otherwise`, at any depth. `RulePredicate` gains `key` (`condition`, `when`, `then.condition`, `otherwise.then.when`, …). The nested slots are included: they are slots of the same top-level rule and have an unambiguous key path (`validations.0.then.condition`); a flow's nested region edge was left out in #26858 only because it has none.
- A map-form `objects` collection has no index to spell, so its findings keep `where` alone, as a map-form `flows` collection's do.
- No new member: `ExprIssue.path` (from #26858) carries it, and `authoring-rules.ts`'s `path: i.path ?? i.where` needs no change. The publish rule is not copied anywhere.
- The runtime gate is untouched: its differential compares the raw positional paths (siblings sit at the same index in every snapshot), `nameKeyFindingPath` re-spells `objects[I]` as `objects.NAME` after it, and `withPublishVerdict`'s `itemRelativeIssuePath` strips that prefix for `_diagnostics`.

## Tests

- New `packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.validation-rule-path.test.ts` (9 cases), one per slot and verdict, each asserting the key path AND the unchanged `where`: the null-guard gate on `condition`; `check()` on `condition`; `check()` and the null-guard gate on `when`; nested `then.condition`, `otherwise.when`, `otherwise.then.condition`; the `parent` root verdict; raw-list indexing past `null` members (object and rule); map-form `objects` keeps no path; a field formula finding gains none; and the publish gate's by-name spelling `objects.rule_probe.validations[1].condition`.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.runtime-authoring-gate.test.ts`: the #22032 block's pin moves from the prose to `objects.fx_rule.validations[0].condition` (the 422 on save and on promotion), with `where` still asserted as the prose; a new case pins the draft read's `_diagnostics[].path` at `validations.0.condition` for both refused bodies; `(d)` door-vs-build parity keeps `rule`/`where`/`message`/`hint` exact and compares `path` once the door's by-name top-level spelling is applied. The #22042 (nested) and #24957 (`parent`) blocks of the same file pinned the same prose path and move the same way. Nothing is skipped.
- Lint suites that pinned `path: where` for a validation-rule finding move the same way: `runtime-gate.object-validation-writes.test.ts` (8 cases; a local `asAtDoor` applies the door's by-name spelling for the door-vs-build `toEqual`s), `validate-expressions.validation-rule-parent.test.ts` (2), `runtime-gate.object-field-existence-spellings.test.ts` (the `validation condition` slot's door path).
- `validate-expressions.test.ts`'s #5017 receiver meta-test reads the new index through the tabled `obj` receiver (`obj.validations.indexOf`), so no excuse is added.

### Ablation (path stamping removed)

At head `7363e13f` (the fix and the moved pins committed; the later changeset commit touches no code), through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` with a trap restore, under the lock:

- Mutation: `if (!rulePath) return;` → `if (!rulePath || 'ablated-27643') return;` in `atSlot` (no finding gains a path). Landed: anchor 1 → 0, blob `a4aad9da` → `fbc41d77`. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint build` exit 0; `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs @objectstack/lint 'ablated-27643'`: marker present in 4 built files, exit 0.
- Red: `validate-expressions.validation-rule-path.test.ts` 7 failed / 2 passed (the map-form and off-rule controls stay green, as they should); `protocol.runtime-authoring-gate.test.ts -t '22032|22042|24957'` 11 failed / 30 passed (the draft-read `_diagnostics[].path` pin among them).
- Restore: blob back to `a4aad9da` = HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty, rebuild exit 0, preflight `--absent` exit 0 (marker absent from all 20 built files, tree clean). Green again: 9/9 and 41/41.
- A first attempt used a comment marker (`/* ablated-27643 */`), which the bundler strips: the preflight answered "marker ABSENT from dist/" (exit 1), so that run's reading is void even though the same suites went red; it was redone with the string marker above.

## Acceptance notes

Readers that match on a validation-rule finding's path, grepped repo-wide at this head (`git grep` for `· validation '`, `· validation rule '` and `.path` beside them):

- `packages/lint` tests: the four files above, updated. Every other lint test matches on `where`, which is unchanged.
- `packages/metadata-protocol`: the #22032, #22042 and #24957 blocks, updated. `withPublishVerdict` needs no change (it already strips an `objects.NAME` prefix).
- `packages/cli`: `os lint` prints `at ${issue.path}` (`authoringFindingToLintIssue`), so for these findings it now prints the key path where it printed the `where` text a second time; the message still leads with `where`. `artifact-packages.ts`'s `findingKey` normalises the top-level index (`objects[3]` → `objects[]`), so its per-package dedupe is unaffected. `os validate` / `os build` / `doctor` print `where`.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/rule-hop-undeclared-related-field.dogfood.test.ts` matches `[rule, where]`, unchanged.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/draftVerdict.ts`: `serverErrorsAt` matches a path by equality, and no Studio field asks for `validations.N.condition` yet, so nothing changes on screen until layer 2 (#27482). `withServerOnlyErrors` dedupes a client error and a server error with the same path and message; with the prose path no client error ever matched, with the key path a client error raised at `validations.N.condition` with the same message is shown once, which is the intended direction.
- `objectql`'s runtime refusal text (`validation rule 'X' on OBJ could not be evaluated`) is a different message on a different surface and is untouched.

In-flight intersection (open PRs at the time of the claim, files listed per PR): only #27592 (head `e2368298`) touches `protocol.runtime-authoring-gate.test.ts`, in the #27069 related-list block near the end of the file (an added `it` and a changed fixture); no hunk overlaps the #22032 / #22042 / #24957 blocks. No open PR touches `validate-expressions.ts` or `authoring-rules.ts`.
